name: offering-01
title: Offering 01 - One Capability, Its Limits, Its Cost And Its State
description: One capability in full: a name, a standfirst, a body, a specification list, a price, an availability reading, a panel and an actions slot. The state set makes in-preview, coming-soon and unavailable first class, so a capability that is planned is rendered as planned rather than as built, and a state with no caller-supplied words throws rather than drawing a bare dot. Every figure, word and currency is the caller's.
